16503524.reason: Repaints every cell in the selected row/column on each query, giving excessive O(k*max(n,m)) work. Counted counterexample is timeout only.

16508247.reason: Column updates iterate range(m), not range(n); in the recorded 5x3 case row 4 remains zero even though both outer columns must be painted.

16559601.reason: Applies each operation literally to all selected cells rather than retaining last row/column timestamps. Fresh full rerun passes the builder-counted test 0020 but first times out on 0022. Neither a timeout nor a now-passing counted pair proves algorithmic WA; do not change the counted evidence silently.

16560711.reason: Operation timestamps start at zero, tying the first column update with every untouched row timestamp; tie is resolved toward rows. For 1x2 with one column-2 paint, returns 0 0 instead of 0 1000000000.

16560789.reason: Prints range(c) rows rather than r, so a valid 5x3 input emits only three rows. Initial rows are aliased as well. Incorrect dimension/shape computation is algorithmic, not a whitespace defect.
